messages:
Maria (CS): Quick heads up — Orion sent over a vendor security questionnaire and flagged SOC2 tabletop evidence + DPA clarifications. They're asking for: last tabletop date + scenario summary, contact RACI, and retention excerpt by EOW. Can Security/Legal chime in? @Devon @Katie :eyes:
Devon (Security): Got it. Do they need raw playbooks or just executive summary?
Maria (CS): They asked for 'evidence of tabletop exercises' — doc examples accepted (runbooks + incident report summaries). We should avoid sharing sensitive logs. Alex will confirm exact ask.
Alex (AM): I pinged their procurement lead. They want: 1) tabletop date & scope, 2) attendee roles (RACI), 3) post-mortem high-level findings. No raw logs. Deadline Friday COB.
Katie (Legal): We can hand over redacted summaries. Need to ensure DPA clause alignment re: third-party disclosures. I'll draft a redaction rubric. Sam can you prepare sanitized export?
Sam (Eng): Yep. I can pull the tabletop summary and redact PII/service names. Need list of fields to keep/remove. Katie, what's your rubric?
Katie (Legal): Keep: date, scope, high-level impact, remediation status. Remove: internal IP, customer IDs, exact hostnames. Use placeholders like <HOST>.
Devon (Security): Also include contact for breach notification timeline excerpt from our DPA (section 4.3). I'll copy the snippet here:
```
We will notify affected parties within 72 hours of incident confirmation.
```
(we'll confirm exact wording from the DPA doc).
Maria (CS): Perfect. Sam — can you drop the sanitized doc here as a PDF by Thu 3pm? I'll attach to their questionnaire. @OnboardingBot please create a shared ticket and set assignees.
OnboardingBot: Ticket #CS-4821 created: 'Orion tabletop evidence request' — assignees: Sam, Katie, Devon. Due: 2026-03-26 15:00 UTC.
Sam (Eng): Uploading draft now: s3://redwood-share/orion/tabletop-summary-redacted_v1.pdf (private link). Please review.
Devon (Security): Reviewed. Two tiny edits requested (removed internal tool name). Katie pls confirm legal ok and then Maria can send.
Katie (Legal): Approved with edits. Maria, go ahead and send. Suggest adding short note about retention policy: 'we retain incident docs for 2 years, per internal policy.'
Maria (CS): Sending now. Will cc Alex and include DPA snippets. Closing thread — will paste sent email here.
Maria (CS): Email sent to procurement@orion.co with attachments + redacted DPA excerpt. They acknowledged receipt. :white_check_mark:
